home.credEvent: SIH26092: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
home.problemTitle:
Finding the right opportunity shouldn't
require navigating complexity.
home.problem1Desc: Entrepreneurs struggle to identify relevant schemes among hundreds of active government programs across different sectors.
home.problem2Desc: Complex statutory requirements, rigid exclusions, and layered demographic criteria (SC/ST, Area, Greenfield) are difficult to understand and verify.
home.problem3Desc: Required documents, financial projections (DPRs), and application pathways vary widely and create significant drop-off friction.
home.problem4Desc: Applicants often do not know where to begin, which portal to use, or which nodal agency/channel partner to approach for sanction.
home.how1Desc: Input your business profile, demographics, and funding needs.
home.how2Desc: We check statutory eligibility without LLM hallucination.
home.how3Desc: Relevant schemes are ranked based on alignment and subsidy value.
home.how4Desc: See exactly which documents you need and where to apply.
home.how5Desc: Find nearby channel partners and nodal banks to submit your file.
home.coverageDesc: SCHEMORA aggregates intelligence across multiple central schemes and maps them to regional active channel partners.
